When Cooling Struggles

AC problems get uncomfortable fast.

Weak cooling, strange noises, poor airflow or a system that stops operating can have several causes. The useful first step is finding out what is actually wrong before deciding whether repair or replacement makes sense.

  • Room not cooling
  • Weak airflow
  • Unit not starting
  • Unusual noise
  • Frequent cycling
  • Uneven comfort
  • Water or drainage concerns
  • Aging mini-split equipment
